findings.finding: Spaces around Latin/placeholder runs (已为 {site} 阻止, macOS 已关闭, 重新打开 Local Operator，) contradict the zh-CN guide (no space) but match the audited ui.browser.media_permission strings shown in the same band ({site} 想要…, macOS 已关闭 Local Operator 的…) — round-1 ZH-N1's corpus-wide call. No change.

系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 equals the audited media_permission hint. Apple's zh-cn help (support.apple.com/zh-cn/guide/mac-help-cn/mchla1b1e1fe) returned HTTP 429 again; a web search surfaced third-party guides (pconline.com.cn/ask/377980.html, php.cn/faq/1970454.html) naming 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 for Ventura and later — secondary evidence only. “允许” quoted like agent_tab_hint.

Round-2 remediation (748f4c83caf) made blocked_hint a devices select, resolving the a2 source observation (“them” for one device); the component now passes devices (browser-media-permission-prompt.tsx:152). Names the device(s) explicitly (麦克风 / 摄像头 / 摄像头和麦克风), matching the band's terms; “允许” quoted in every arm.

The other 8 keys are byte-identical to the values audited as mp1843-a2-zh-cn at 99d69f364e3 (JSON key-by-key compare of git show 99d69f364e3: vs 748f4c83caf:; only blocked_hint differs in en, context and this locale); a2 verdicts on them are carried, re-run mechanically here.
